elena: Heads-up — acmehealth POC: they're not seeing traces in Console for requests that are in Splunk. Logs show request IDs but Console shows gaps. Anyone seen this?
aj: I was on the call — they say frontend adds X-Request-Id but backends sometimes replace it with our load balancer request id.
paul: Can you paste a sample log line?
elena: Sure: `2024-07-12T15:22:11Z INFO request completed method=POST path=/v1/generate status=200 request_id=abcd-1234` — Splunk has `request_id`, console trace explorer shows no `trace_id`.
sre-bot: Note: trace linking requires `trace_id` to be present in the structured logs or set the `trace_header` mapping in the ingest config.
aj: Check header normalization — some proxies lowercase headers; try sending `x-trace-id` as well.
elena: Quick test curl I asked them to run:
```
curl -H "X-Trace-Id: acme-req-789" -H "X-Request-Id: acme-req-789" https://api.redwood.ai/ingest/logs -d '{"msg":"test"}'
```
ops-lucas: They also hit 429s during the spike earlier. Their ingest rate was ~8k req/s and default demo plan has soft quota. 429 responses drop trace linkage.
paul: 429s will drop ingestion of some spans — recommend sampling + burst buffer. For POC we can temporarily bump quota for them.
sales-beth: Pricing question from the AE: what's the temporary overage for a week of increased ingest? Need a range I can give the buyer.
aj: For demo bump we usually do a grace bump (no charge) for up to 48h. Anything longer we quote per-GB at $X/GB — I'll loop in finance.
elena: Also, dashboard roles: customer can't see traces in Console because their user is org-readonly. Need to give `traces.viewer` role.
ops-lucas: Quick checklist I sent them:
- ensure `X-Trace-Id` present
- set header mapping: `trace_header: X-Trace-Id`
- enable `trace_export=true` in POC config
- confirm user role `traces.viewer`
aj: To map header in their Quickstart `redwood-config.yaml`:
```
ingest:
  trace_header: "X-Trace-Id"
  sampling:
    mode: adaptive
```
elena: They also asked about exporting full logs to Splunk — current POC uses splunk-hec. We need to ensure trace_id is a top-level field in the JSON payload, not just embedded in message.
paul: Example payload we accept:
`{"ts":"2024-07-12T15:22:11Z","level":"info","trace_id":"acme-req-789","msg":"..."}`
If Splunk forwarder restructures fields, the trace_id may be under `event.message` — losing linkage.
elena: Action items: aj to request 48h quota bump; ops-lucas to send role change instructions; paul to share small script to normalize logs; I'll follow up with customer.
sales-beth: Thanks — can we get the temporary bump today? AE is on the call.
aj: Doing it now, ping me if 429s persist.
elena: thanks :thumbsup: 
sre-bot: Incident note created: INC-2043 POC ingest gap — assigned to aj, ops-lucas, paul
